name: TensorPM v1.41.3
body:
# Changelog - v1.41.3

This update gives the welcome screen a new background film.

## 🎉 New Features

- **A new welcome film:** the first screen you see after installing TensorPM now shows seven
  complex projects from very different worlds: a module docking at a space station, a rotor blade
  lifted onto an offshore wind turbine at sunrise, the final assembly of a wide-body aircraft, a
  robot welding line, the inside of a fusion reactor, an underwater robot working on the seabed,
  and a giant telescope under the Milky Way. The film is sharper than before (1080p) and loops
  without a visible seam.

## 🏗️ Improvements

- **Readable text on every scene:** the film is slightly darker behind the logo, the title and the
  start button, so the white text stays easy to read.
- **Respects "Reduce motion":** if your system is set to reduce motion, the welcome screen shows a
  still image instead of the moving film.
- **Faster first paint:** a still image is shown while the film loads, so the welcome screen never
  starts on an empty background.

---

## 📅 Release Info

- **Version**: 1.41.3
- **Release Date**: 2026-10-03
- **Previous Version**: 1.41.2
